items.defectStatement: The second definition of OptimizedImage.downsize replaces the width/height definition. ResizeEmoji's five-argument call consequently raises ArgumentError instead of resizing the emoji.
obligations: Accept existing width/height calls with and without options.
Accept dimensions-string calls with and without options.
Forward the correct geometry and unchanged options to optimize.
items.exampleFix:
def self.downsize(from, to, dimensions, max_height_or_opts=nil, opts={})
    if max_height_or_opts.is_a?(Hash)
      opts = max_height_or_opts
    elsif !max_height_or_opts.nil?
      dimensions = "#{dimensions}x#{max_height_or_opts}"
    end
    optimize("downsize", from, to, dimensions, opts)
  end
items.notes: Deleting either definition alone breaks one calling convention. A single dispatching method fixes both within the anchor; all four calling forms were checked with an isolated Ruby probe.

items.defectStatement: The upload loop supplies "80%" to downsizing, but the animated GIF backend passes that value to gifsicle --resize-fit, which requires pixel geometry. Animated downsizing therefore fails, and the ignored failure is retried up to five times.
obligations: Supply valid positive pixel geometry when using the animated backend.
Calculate successive reductions from the current image dimensions.
Preserve the configured size threshold, animation option, and bounded attempts.
Stop retrying when dimensions cannot be read or downsizing fails.
items.exampleFix:
# allow users to upload large images that will be automatically reduced to allowed size
      if tempfile && tempfile.size > 0 && SiteSetting.max_image_size_kb > 0 && FileHelper.is_image?(filename)
        attempt = 5
        while attempt > 0 && tempfile.size > SiteSetting.max_image_size_kb.kilobytes
          image_size = FastImage.size(tempfile.path) rescue nil
          break unless image_size && image_size.all? { |dimension| dimension && dimension > 0 }
          dimensions = image_size.map { |dimension| [(dimension * 0.8).floor, 1].max }.join("x")
          break unless OptimizedImage.downsize(tempfile.path, tempfile.path, dimensions, allow_animation: SiteSetting.allow_animated_thumbnails)
          attempt -= 1
        end
items.notes: The repository confirms FastImage.size and the boolean downsizing result; their contracts are absent from this item's frozen input. Do not assume percentage geometry is universally invalid for ImageMagick. GIF suffix detection is a separate defect.

items.defectStatement: When an uploaded GIF's tempfile path lacks a .gif suffix, OptimizedImage.optimize selects its static converter despite allow_animation being enabled. That converter reads only frame zero, permanently flattening the oversized animation.
obligations: Select animated processing for GIF uploads when animation is enabled, regardless of the incoming tempfile suffix.
Preserve the animation while reducing its dimensions.
Make the successfully processed bytes available through the original upload tempfile.
Clean up any additional temporary file on success or failure.
items.exampleFix:
if SiteSetting.allow_animated_thumbnails && filename =~ /\.gif$/i
            animation_file = Tempfile.new(["discourse-upload-animation", ".gif"])
            begin
              FileUtils.cp(tempfile.path, animation_file.path)
              image_size = FastImage.size(animation_file.path) rescue nil
              break unless image_size && image_size.all? { |dimension| dimension && dimension > 0 }
              dimensions = image_size.map { |dimension| [(dimension * 0.8).floor, 1].max }.join("x")
              break unless OptimizedImage.downsize(animation_file.path, animation_file.path, dimensions, allow_animation: true)
              FileUtils.cp(animation_file.path, tempfile.path)
            ensure
              animation_file.close!
            end
          else
            OptimizedImage.downsize(tempfile.path, tempfile.path, "80%", allow_animation: SiteSetting.allow_animated_thumbnails)
          end
items.notes: A one-line anchor may be replaced by multiple statements. This example also supplies pixel geometry because enabling gifsicle exposes #03; that backend requirement and the dimension-reading API are absent from this item's frozen input. Passing a new format option alone would require changing the optimizer.

items.defectStatement: FileHelper.is_image? includes SVG, so oversized SVG uploads enter the raster downsizing loop. Rewriting the vector file can rasterize or corrupt it before Upload.create_for attempts to parse it as SVG.
obligations: Exclude SVG filenames from automatic raster downsizing, case-insensitively.
Preserve the existing downsizing eligibility and loop for other image formats.
Leave SVG bytes intact for normal upload parsing and validation.
items.exampleFix:
# allow users to upload large raster images that will be automatically reduced to allowed size
      if tempfile && tempfile.size > 0 && SiteSetting.max_image_size_kb > 0 && FileHelper.is_image?(filename) && filename !~ /\.svg$/i
        attempt = 5
        while attempt > 0 && tempfile.size > SiteSetting.max_image_size_kb.kilobytes
          OptimizedImage.downsize(tempfile.path, tempfile.path, "80%", allow_animation: SiteSetting.allow_animated_thumbnails)
items.notes: The replacement deliberately leaves the loop decrement and closing ends outside the anchor unchanged. Oversized SVGs can still be rejected by normal upload validation.

items.defectStatement: API URL downloads embed the request-controlled type in the tempfile name, and the new downsizing loop passes that path into an unescaped shell command. Shell metacharacters in type can consequently execute commands during oversized-image processing.
obligations: Prevent shell metacharacters supplied through type from reaching downsizing.
Continue accepting ordinary upload identifiers such as avatar, composer, and profile_background.
Reject unsafe identifiers before invoking the optimizer.
Preserve normal size checks and bounded downsizing for accepted identifiers.
items.exampleFix:
unless type.is_a?(String) && /\A[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+\z/.match(type)
        return { errors: ["Invalid upload type"] }
      end
      if tempfile && tempfile.size > 0 && SiteSetting.max_image_size_kb > 0 && FileHelper.is_image?(filename)
        attempt = 5
        while attempt > 0 && tempfile.size > SiteSetting.max_image_size_kb.kilobytes
          OptimizedImage.downsize(tempfile.path, tempfile.path, "80%", allow_animation: SiteSetting.allow_animated_thumbnails)
          attempt -= 1
        end
items.notes: Validation can be inserted inside this replacement range before the vulnerable call, making the reported type-injection defect locally fixable. This is not general shell hardening. Merely shell-escaping the path passed to downsize can break its filesystem operations.

items.defectStatement: The HTTP 413 handler claims a fixed 10 MB maximum even though the rejecting server or proxy may enforce a different limit. Users therefore receive potentially false guidance about which upload size will succeed.
obligations: Remove the unsupported claim that the enforced maximum is 10 MB.
Continue displaying an upload error for HTTP 413.
Preserve the handler's immediate return and other status handling.
items.notes: The existing generic translation is visible in the frozen window. A dedicated size-related message without a number is also valid if available; inventing a translation key is not. A site-setting limit may still differ from a proxy's limit.
